primitives.name: Temporal Urgency Gradient
primitives.verbatim_quote: Hurry up and be the first man to line up.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'t': 'time in seconds', 'u(t)': 'urgency level at time t, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Urgency increases linearly with time delay from optimal action onset.
primitives.breakdown_regime: u(t) → ∞ as t → 0, indicating critical timing failure.

layer2.mapping: GSI urgency posterior maps to GSE urgency kernel via temporal gradient convergence.
layer2.telemetry: Time-to-action deviation from optimal line-up window.

primitives.name: Positional Readiness Field
primitives.verbatim_quote: No one can play the game unless he is with the ball all the time.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'r(t)': 'position vector of player at time t, meters', 'b(t)': 'ball position vector at time t, meters', 'd(r,b)(t)': 'distance between player and ball at time t, meters'}
primitives.assumptions: Player must maintain d(r,b)(t) ≤ threshold for active participation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: d(r,b)(t) > threshold implies inactive state or disqualification.

layer2.mapping: GSI readiness score maps to GSE field proximity kernel via distance threshold.
layer2.telemetry: Distance from ball to player during active play.

primitives.name: Block Impact Acceleration
primitives.verbatim_quote: Hurry up and block your man hard when you should block.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'a_b': 'block acceleration, m/s²', 'F_b': 'block force applied, newtons', 'm_p': 'player mass, kg'}
primitives.assumptions: Force applied is proportional to acceleration under inertia constraint.
primitives.breakdown_regime: a_b → ∞ implies collision failure or insufficient force application.

layer2.mapping: GSI impact score maps to GSE block kernel via impulse magnitude.
